steps: Asian session high or low swept
1H trend agrees with the sweep direction (continuation)
5M Break of Structure (BOS) in the trend direction
Unmitigated 5M Fair Value Gap (FVG) found after the BOS
asians_continuation.notes: Alerts the moment the FVG forms (pending limit order), not after price taps it.

steps: Asian session high or low swept
1H trend disagrees with the sweep direction (reversal)
5M Change of Character (CHoCH) - close beyond the causal swing
15M Fair Value Gap (FVG) zone found
asians_reversal.notes: Alerts right after the CHoCH confirms, at the 15M zone.

london_tt.entry_type: Stop order (buy-stop/sell-stop) at the 15M candle's high/low
steps: Asian session 15M trend is clear
Pullback of at least 25% of the Asian session's range
First 15M candle after London open closes
First 30M candle after London open agrees with the Asian trend
london_tt.notes: TP shown is a 1:1 minimum - check higher timeframes for a nearer untapped swing to extend it.

steps: Asian session high or low swept
Causal swing (the swing that supported the sweep) identified
5M Change of Character (CHoCH) - close beyond that swing
Unmitigated Fair Value Gap (FVG) found in the displacement leg
asian_tt.notes: Entry is the FVG's midpoint; SL at the causal swing; TP at the opposite Asian session extreme.

newyork.notes: 9AM Candle Range model. TP is the opposite side of the 8AM range.

strategy_6.session: None - runs at any time of day
steps: A recent reference range's high or low is swept
Market Structure Shift (MSS) - close beyond the opposing swing
Unmitigated Fair Value Gap (FVG) found after the MSS
strategy_6.notes: Session-agnostic version of the sweep+structure-break+FVG concept - not tied to a specific killzone, so it can catch setups the session-restricted strategies miss.

strategy_7.session: None - runs at any time of day
steps: A recent reference range's high or low is swept
A Balanced Price Range (BPR) forms - an overlap between a bullish and a bearish Fair Value Gap
strategy_7.notes: Entry is at the BPR's midpoint, traded in the direction of whichever FVG formed more recently.

strategy_8.session: None - runs at any time of day
steps: Smart Money Divergence (SMT) found vs the correlated instrument - the primary sweeps a high/low the correlated one does not
Market Structure Shift (MSS) confirms the divergence direction
Inversion Fair Value Gap (IFVG) found after the MSS
strategy_8.notes: Never fires a false signal - if the correlated instrument's data is unavailable, this strategy produces nothing rather than guessing.

strategy_9.session: None - runs at any time of day
steps: Smart Money Divergence (SMT) found vs the correlated instrument
Market Structure Shift (MSS) confirms the divergence direction
A Breaker Block found - an order block that failed and flipped role, in the MSS direction
strategy_9.notes: Same SMT/MSS base as Strategy 8, but the entry zone is a breaker block instead of an IFVG.

strategy_10.display_name: Liquidity Sweep + MSS + Breaker Block + FVG (Strategy 10)
strategy_10.session: None - runs at any time of day
steps: A recent reference range's high or low is swept
Market Structure Shift (MSS) - close beyond the opposing swing
A Breaker Block found in the MSS direction
Unmitigated Fair Value Gap (FVG) found in the same direction
strategy_10.notes: Highest-conviction combo strategy - requires BOTH a breaker block AND an FVG to align, not just one.
